name: Earth sea-level air (reference)
source: Challenge statement: Earth's sea-level pressure is 14.7 psi; air holds about 21% oxygen.
notes: A narrow band (±1 point O2, ±0.5 psi) so that tests run 'in air at 1 atm' count as matches.

name: Moon base and pressurized rover (expected)
source: Challenge statement: intermediate atmosphere between a spacesuit and Earth's; likely 30% oxygen or greater at 10.2 psi or less.
notes: Upper oxygen bound and lower pressure bound are the spacesuit values, the outer limits the statement gives.

name: Spacesuit
source: Challenge statement: spacesuits hold 100% oxygen at 4.3 psi.
notes: Small tolerance band around the stated point.
